name: Gutterson Garage
description: Brick and concrete. Has cracks, highballs, and some cool problems. Hosts the technical Gut Punch.

name: Lafayette
description: Home to some cool boulders on the east entrance. Also, the four chimneys. The corner on the backside of the theatre is included in this area.

name: Williams
description: The granite masonry blocks on this building offer some climbing, but no topouts.

name: Billings
description: The climbs described in this area all involve the red masnory blocks with natural crimps.

name: Ira Allen
description: The climbs in this area are all on the east side of the building. They are all pretty bouldery and involve standard brick crimps.

name: Votey
description: Votey has lot's of boulderable architecture, but most lines are one move. You could probably climb the whole building if you knew how to get down.

name: The Diaper
description: The sculpture with the picnic table by redstone lofts. You can climb it

name: L&L
description: The only climb here is the crack on the mural.

name: Church St Garage
description: Home to some cool crack climbs, and the hardest crack boulder in Vermont!

name: Cathedral Church
description: Probable some cool climbs here! Very little is established.

name: Cherry St Garage
description: Has a couple of climbs in the alley, I'm not sure if there is more potential or not.

name: Ethan Allen Park
description: The Ethan Allen Tower hosts a historical builder: "Henry Can't Do It". A blurb about this climb from Travis Peckham can be found in Vermont Rock.

name: St. Michael's
description: I have climbed a couple of the splitters visible from the road. There are probably a lot more. I've never gone all the way to the top of the tall one.
